directive.quote: Every engine job of the old Worker's rust-engine backlog rows works on the new engine, one to one or better.

preserve: every passkey row carries its provenance, fixed when it is saved: sign-up known at once; known-passkey and notice known after 72 hours; unvouched never
a passkey added without a confirmation waits out the notice only on an account with no known passkey or while a recovery waits (and no sooner than it ends); beside a known passkey it is unvouched
a row with no provenance is never known until it is classified once, unvouched beside a known passkey, else waiting from then, and told
any use of a known passkey (signing in, confirming) cancels every waiting notice passkey and a waiting recovery; one a known passkey vouched for waits on
a recovery that ran its wait unknows every passkey known before it started; it can be cancelled before

removing a way in, replacing a held way and ending another browser are held while anything waits, and on an account with a known passkey need that passkey's confirmation bound to exactly that change; with no known passkey the change goes (the stated risk)
a refusal for want of a confirmation names step_needed passkey-confirmation and the exact change
a known passkey goes only with a known passkey's confirmation; one that is not known goes with the sign-in alone
a known passkey vouches for another, which is known after its notice
every passkey but the sign-up one, every recovery and every confirmation is a notice; at most 3 counted notices in 24 hours, and an add or a recovery past that is refused
the wait and the notice bounds are the computer's DATA, never an account's row
allowed_deltas: the delayed account change (delete or move, delayedChange, cancelDelayed) drops out: this sign-in has no operation that deletes or moves an account

telling the person on every channel and by mail drops out: the engine has no channel; every notice is kept with its words in the account's authority row (lists family, passkey-recovery:<account>) and answered by sign-in:passkeys for the tool that tells the person
the legacy sign-up evidence and the operator's migration drop out: no sign-up record exists here (and no guard read it there)
a confirmation carried into the add-a-passkey ceremony is replaced by a vouch afterwards, which gives the same provenance and wait
the confirmation is a passkey ceremony over a challenge bound to the change's key (sign-in:confirm-change, passkeys::confirm_options and confirm) instead of src/cap-change.mjs's held confirmation

change names are remove-way, replace-way, end-session, remove-passkey and vouch-passkey (one way row covers the old email, phone, password, authenticator and backup-codes changes); ceiling, billing, account and operator link changes are features or have no operation here

the Sign-in & security page has no passkey confirmation step yet: on an account with a known passkey a way is removed or replaced through the door with a confirmation, and the page refuses with the needs_known_passkey words
banned_substitutions: the wait read from an account's own row
a passkey known with no provenance
a central store of passkey authority
telling the person through a vendor named in engine code
